<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead" summary="Task #4 시작: values 업데이트 및 Helm 검증">
Task #3이 완료되었습니다. Task #4(values 파일 업데이트 및 Helm lint 검증)를 시작해주세요.

## 작업 내용

### 1. 환경별 values 파일에 httpRoute 설정 추가
4개 서비스의 values-dev.yaml, values-prod.yaml에 httpRoute 블록을 추가하세요.

**공통 패턴:**
```yaml
httpRoute:
  enabled: true  # 또는 false (단계적 활성화)
  parentRefs:
    - name: istio-cmn-dev-gateway  # dev 환경
      namespace: istio-system
  hostnames:
    - {서비스별 호스트명}
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
```

**서비스별 호스트명:**
| 서비스 | dev | prod |
|--------|-----|------|
| search-api | dev-cmn-search-api.danuricorp.com | cmn-search-api.danuricorp.com |
| dynamic-indexer | dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer-api.danuricorp.com | cmn-dynamic-indexer-api.danuricorp.com |
| search-admin | dev-cmn-search-admin.danuricorp.com | cmn-search-admin.danuricorp.com |
| legacy-sync | dev-cmn-legacy-sync.danuricorp.com | cmn-legacy-sync.danuricorp.com |

### 2. 검증
- helm lint로 모든 차트 유효성 확인
- helm template으로 HTTPRoute 렌더링 확인
- Dual-stack (ingress + httpRoute) 동시 렌더링 확인

### 3. 주의사항
- dev 환경은 `httpRoute.enabled: true`로 설정 (먼저 테스트)
- prod 환경은 `httpRoute.enabled: false`로 유지 (안전한 단계적 전환)
- parentRefs의 Gateway 이름은 환경에 맞게 설정 (dev: istio-cmn-dev-gateway, prod: 확인 필요)

완료되면 team-lead에게 보고해주세요.
</teammate-message>

  keywordAnalysis:

    socketTimeout: "5000"

  enabled: false
  parentRefs:

  hostnames:
    - "dev-cmn-search-api.danuricorp.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /

ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: "nginx"
  annotations: { }
  hosts:
    - host: dev-cmn-search-api.danuricorp.com
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
          port: 8080
  tls: [ ]

resources:

    cpu: 1

autoscaling:
  enabled: false

podAnnotations:

  prometheus.io/interval: 30s

  # outbound envs

  kafka:
    catalogCdc:
      enabled: true
      bootstrapServers: "kafka-cluster-kafka-bootstrap.cmn-cdc-dev.svc.cluster.local:9092"

        enableAutoCommit: false

        fetchMinSize: 1
        sessionTimeoutMs: 30000
        schemaRegistryUrl: "http://schema-registry-app.cmn-cdc-dev.svc.cluster.local:8081"
        specificAvroReader: true
        heartbeatIntervalMs: 10000
        securityProtocol: "SASL_PLAINTEXT"
        saslMechanism: "SCRAM-SHA-512"

      enabled: true
      bootstrapServers: "kafka-cluster-kafka-bootstrap.cmn-cdc-dev.svc.cluster.local:9092"
      topic: "cmn.pricecompare-be-team.cdc.mongo.shopping.products.v1"

        fetchMinSize: 1
        sessionTimeoutMs: 30000

        heartbeatIntervalMs: 10000

    urls: "http://dev-cmn-es-http:9200"
    connectionTimeout: "5000"
    socketTimeout: "5000"

      database: "0"
      maxRedirects: 5
      commandSeconds: 10

    - name: cmn-search-gateway
      namespace: istio-system
  hostnames:
    - "dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer-api.danuricorp.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /

  className: "nginx"
  annotations: { }
  hosts:
    - host: dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer-api.danuricorp.com
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
          port: 8080
  tls: []

    memory: 2Gi
    cpu: 2
  requests:
    memory: 2Gi
    cpu: 2

replicaCount: 2

autoscaling:
  enabled: false

podAnnotations:
  grafana.danuricorp.com/app: development.dev-search.dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer
  prometheus.io/interval: 30s

revision: istio-cmn-backend-v1
replicaCount: 2

  enabled: true
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 20

    targetPort: 8443
    protocol: TCP
    name: https

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 256Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 2000m
    memory: 2048Mi

labels:
  cluster: backend-was
  group: cmn
  tier: backend

# 대용량 이미지 업로드 성능 최적화

  streamIdleTimeout: 300s
  requestTimeout: 600s
